method.no_detection_outcome: Attempts>0 with no U8/U9 across assigned workloads (normally U1; legacy U7 accepted)
method.pending_status: U1 is acceptable only when Attempts>0, where it means no PC-detection status was observed; zero-attempt U1 remains unresolved
method.U7_assignment: none in v1.1.1; no-detection is derived from Attempts and absence of U8/U9
method.aggregation: union of unique (target_path, SA polarity) across the full balanced matrix; this file is an any-workload summary, while rank_fault_simulation.py computes frequency-aware balanced ranking
method.balanced_matrix_note: Every candidate is exercised under the same 8 workloads x 3 seed variants. Primary ranking is produced separately from repeated fault executions, not from this union metric.

validation_metrics.zoix_attempt_rate: attempted_unique / requested; execution/testability coverage, not a pure FIF surrogate
validation_metrics.zoix_pc_nonimpact_given_attempted_rate: PC-not-detected attempted / all actually attempted faults
validation_metrics.zoix_pc_classification_given_attempted_r: (PC-detected + PC-not-detected) / all actually attempted faults; should be 1.0 in a resolved dataset
validation_metrics.zoix_overall_pc_impact_rate: PC-detected / all requested SA0/SA1 faults; width-normalized combined reverse-fault impact
